title: Strategist Sim 1: Scaling Safely to ₹5k/Day
brief: A direct-to-consumer Ayurvedic skincare brand in Mumbai wants to scale daily spend to ₹5,000/day for 7 days (Total ₹35,000). Set up your campaign parameters with broad reach, auto-placements, and high-performing dynamic creatives to achieve at least 70 purchases while maintaining an overall ROAS of at least 3.0x!
